title: 第1章 你的梦，值多少钱？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

游戏上线这天，司陇起床第一时间下载好，放在电脑桌面上却迟迟还没

她根本没时间玩，即使今天是五一假期。

按照正常情况，作为一名资深宅女的她，应该正在游戏里畅游，旁边还得有一瓶冰可乐。

也不能少了她特意为这款游戏提前准备的，半个冰西瓜。

谁懂，这简直是最高礼仪。

毕竟这是她期待已久，以梦境为主题的，赛博朋克梦核全息开放自由探索世界。

游戏上线前的预热，热度已超过众多热门榜单，一直位居玩家最想玩的游戏榜首。

可这本该完美的快乐假期又再次被领导打破。

司陇双目无神，看着电脑上和领导的对话框。

其中两个未接来电，一个早上11点打来，另一个11点05分，最后已接的通话记录是11点10分。

很好，每五分钟一个夺命连环call，看得出来领导是真着急了。

没有在一大早打来，已经算是她能睡个懒觉的幸运日。

而最新的对话则停留在两段超长的60秒语音和一个文件上。

60秒的语音根本不想点开听，光是看到两条长长的语音条就已经是非常头痛的程度。

领导最后还补了一句，小司啊，最迟晚上8点之前给我。

搞什么啊......司陇郁闷地抓了抓头发。

我是你的小厮吧！还小司。

可虽然心里这样想着，她手上还是熟练地打出回复，收到。

司陇看着对话框，开始陷入了拖延状态。

昨天刚从牛马切换到快乐宅女，此时又要再切换回去，极其地不情愿。

“叮。”

邮箱突然进了一封新邮件。

电脑桌面右上角跳出提示，邮件主题为【永夜梦主】游戏账号注册须知。

司陇噌的一下眼睛就亮了，反正领导的东西不是晚上八点才要嘛，现在先摸会鱼也不碍事的吧。

先把游戏账号注册好，晚上加完班再好好玩，岂不美哉。

并且游戏才刚刚上线，有经验的老玩家都懂，好的游戏名是要抓紧时间抢先注册的。

想到此司陇的心情又好了起来，迫不及待地点开了那封邮件。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

On the day the game was launched, Si Long downloaded it as soon as he got up, but it still hasn’t been put on the computer desktop.

She had no time to play at all, even though it was the May Day holiday.

Under normal circumstances, as a senior otaku, she should be enjoying herself in the game, with a bottle of iced Coke next to her.

It is also indispensable that she specially prepared it for this game, half an iced watermelon.

Who knows, this is simply the highest etiquette.

After all, this is her long-awaited, dream-themed, cyberpunk dreamcore holographic open and free exploration of the world.

In the warm-up period before the game was launched, its popularity has exceeded many popular lists, and it has always been at the top of the list of games that players most want to play.

But this supposedly perfect happy holiday was once again broken by the leader.

Si Long's eyes were blank as he looked at the dialog box with his boss on the computer.

Among the two missed calls, one came at 11 a.m. and the other at 11:05 a.m. The last call recorded was at 11:10 a.m.

Very good. There is a fatal call every five minutes. It can be seen that the leader is really anxious.

Since he didn't call early in the morning, it was considered a lucky day for her to sleep in.

The latest conversation stopped at two long 60-second voices and a file.

I don’t want to click on the 60-second voice to listen to it. Just seeing two long voice bars is already a headache.

The leader finally added, Xiao Si, give it to me before 8pm at the latest.

What are you doing...Si Long scratched his hair depressedly.

I'm your little boy!Also Xiao Si.

But even though she was thinking this in her mind, she still typed out the reply skillfully and received it.

Si Long looked at the dialog box and began to delay.

I just switched from cow horse to happy home girl yesterday, and now I have to switch back again, which is extremely reluctant.

"Ding."

Suddenly a new email arrived in the mailbox.

A prompt popped up in the upper right corner of the computer desktop, and the subject of the email was [Eternal Night Dream Lord] Game Account Registration Instructions.

Si Long's eyes suddenly lit up. After all, the leader didn't want the things until eight o'clock in the evening, so it wouldn't hurt if he could fish first.

Wouldn't it be nice to register a game account first and then have fun after working overtime at night?

And the game has just been launched. Experienced players know that with a good game name, you must hurry up and register first.

Thinking of this, Silong's mood improved again and he couldn't wait to open the email.
